text: (a) 5 points Consider a hash table implemented as an array, T[], indexed from 0...16. Hashing is carried out using double hashing, with h;(k) = k mod 17 and hy(k) = k*+1 mod 17. Show the insertion of: 45,99, 32,96, 25, 36, 83,27, 21,49, 51, 8, or explain why it is that certain keys are not inserted.
